item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "1588b45f6147eb4d77b5c19cf3280e540073fec5858fce3fd13575659c8a1115",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a finite-component field Q and flux F, every real a, b, and s satisfy both interval integrability of x ↦ Q(x,s) and differentiability at s of τ ↦ ∫_a^b Q(x,τ) dx, with derivative F(Q(a,s)) − F(Q(b,s)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes the integral balance law and spatial interval integrability at every real time, not just the selected time t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Maps speed to the one-by-one real matrix whose sole entry is speed.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient matrix is [speed], with no sign or nonzero restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Maps a square matrix A and a state v to the matrix-vector product Av.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the flux as multiplication by [speed].",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For scalar q, this is exactly LocalDef007 q speed x t.",
      "effect_on_target": "The second conclusion asserts scalar time and space derivatives satisfying the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Embeds q(x,s) into the function on Fin 1 taking the value q(x,s) at its unique index.",
      "effect_on_target": "Converts the scalar field into a one-component vector field without changing its values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on a function space ι → Real is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity structure needed for derivatives of the embedded field; it imposes no hypothesis on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For a real normed vector space E, there exist u,v in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative u at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative v at x, and u + speed • v = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "At each x the conclusion provides scalar derivative witnesses and their exact equation; these witnesses may depend on x and the fixed parameters.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication in any real normed vector space is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the derivative predicates in LocalDef007; the target specializes the space to Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real addition used in module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar multiplication on Real is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication of an algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the self-algebra action of Real in the continuity structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction requiring both propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both final conclusions, both clauses of the integral law, and all clauses of the derivative-witness conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Continuous",
      "meaning": "Continuity of a function between the specified topological spaces.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the residual x ↦ qt(x) + fluxx(x) to be continuous on all of Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains a densely normed field as a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar field structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the monoid action underlying a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action used on vector coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real addition and multiplication for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux equality is equality of functions on Fin 1; the transport residual equals scalar zero exactly.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring and division operations of a field as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an algebraic structure on all real numbers; it does not restrict them to nonnegative numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has exactly one element, 0, so states and derivative values each have one real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates the elements 0 through n−1 of Fin n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the matrix-vector sum a sum over the singleton index set.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Fin.instOfNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural numeral as an element of nonempty Fin n using Fin.ofNat.",
      "effect_on_target": "The index literal 0 denotes the sole element of Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects the addition operation of the specified heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses pointwise vector addition in the residual and real addition in the scalar equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the multiplication operation of the specified heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux formula multiplies speed by the real coordinate state(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the point, expressed using the neighborhood filter there and a fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "All derivatives are ordinary unrestricted real-variable derivatives, including vector-valued derivatives; these assertions include existence of the derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure underlying an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real normed-space structure for coordinatewise differentiation and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "The function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability conditions cover either endpoint order and every bounded interval; no condition a ≤ b is present.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication is jointly continuous for a module topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of the real scalar action used in derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has continuous semiring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers the standard continuity of real operations into the scalar-action construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has a module topology over itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of Real acting on itself; it adds no condition on the field q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure from the specified measure-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every integral and integrability predicate uses the same standard real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves coordinatewise real scalar multiplication in the derivative spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action hierarchy without changing real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid underlying a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the multiplicative monoid of all reals, including zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real scalar action on coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite dimension 1 and the index numeral 0; it is not the domain of space or time.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Nat.instNeZeroSucc",
      "meaning": "Every natural successor n+1 is nonzero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Justifies the numeral instance for Fin 1; it imposes no nonzero condition on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and commutative multiplication while forgetting an associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker interface to real ring operations for topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real operations in the topological-ring interface.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid of a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real addition and zero for modules and finite sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets norm data while retaining the nonunital commutative ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring structure without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring underlying its commutative version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real norm and algebra needed for coordinate normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive normed setting for real coordinate spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the weaker nonunital nonassociative semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the usual normed real field used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting commutativity as a required interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate normed groups used to construct the norm on Fin 1 → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its associated extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm structure used by the interval-integrability predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's operations and metric in a structure that does not require a unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real ring interface used for continuity of operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the ring, norm, and pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the ordinary real norm in the derivative and scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses ordinary real field operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the standard real metric and ring structure for scalar continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar module of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real linear structure used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a numeral using its specified type's numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves dimension 1, coordinate 0, and additive zero in their respective types.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Equips functions I → β with the pointwise module structure inherited from β.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative vectors form the real vector space of functions Fin 1 → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a function space with pointwise commutative additive group operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, negation, subtraction, and zero act coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The residual's sole coordinate is qt(x)(0)+fluxx(x)(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a finite product of normed additive commutative groups its product normed group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes one-component states valid values for the vector-valued interval integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a finite product of normed additive groups its product normed group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm used to test integrability of qt and fluxx; with one coordinate this is the real absolute-value norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "Gives a finite product of normed spaces its coordinatewise scalar action and compatible product norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed-space structure for integration of one-component vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Defines the product topology through the coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Continuity and convergence of one-component vectors are equivalent to continuity and convergence of their sole real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the ordinary real metric to the topology used in derivatives and continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips a real-or-complex-like field with its real inner product space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "At Real this supplies the usual real normed-space structure; it introduces no complex-valued field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Space, time, speed, field values, and scalar derivative witnesses are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real normed field has densely available positive norm sizes.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial normed scalar field needed for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Ordinary addition of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines coordinate addition and addition in the scalar transport residual.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real zero, addition, and additive inverses in the vector and derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure inherited from the real field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports Real as an algebra over itself with ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Ordinary multiplication of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "The explicit scalar flux value is speed times state(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real numbers as an RCLike field, with real-part map the identity and imaginary-part map and distinguished I equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides standard real analytic structures; no additional complex coordinates occur.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary arithmetic to the modules and matrix product.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The standard measure-space instance on Real, whose volume is real Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "All spatial integrals and integrability assumptions use real volume.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group with its usual absolute-value norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the normed coordinate space for vector-valued integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The ordinary real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies consistent real normed and topological structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its absolute-value norm and standard metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and norm for all derivatives and real normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is d(x,y)=|x−y|, with the corresponding uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The continuity and derivative statements use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-module topology without restricting the real domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring and division structure of a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker algebraic interface for Real with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the real action used on coordinates of the vector-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains ring operations, norm, and pseudometric while dropping a unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive seminormed structure used for normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring underlying a commutative seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real topology in the scalar-action construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric space underlying a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual metric-derived real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, one, and zero from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative structure of real scalars, allowing zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring operations in a structure that does not require a unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real additive and multiplicative operations for modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the real metric topology available to HasDerivAt and Continuous.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise scalar multiplication on a product is jointly continuous when it is jointly continuous in every coordinate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports derivatives with values in Fin 1 → Real without adding regularity assumptions on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition to pointwise vector addition or real addition as appropriate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the flux formula to ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "Real is a topological ring under its standard topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real operations used to establish continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",

  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify a function q: Real × Real → Real, written q(x,s), with the first argument serving as space and the second as time.",
      "Universally quantify speed c ∈ Real and a selected time t ∈ Real.",
      "Universally quantify qt, qx, fluxx: Real → V, where V is the real vector space Fin 1 → Real.",
      "In the integral-balance assumption, a, b, and s range independently over all real numbers; its time variable s is independent of the selected time t.",
      "In the derivative assumptions and final transport conclusion, x ranges over all real numbers. In the integrability and interchange assumptions, a and b range independently over all real numbers.",
      "In the first conclusion, state ranges over all of V; its output index ranges over Fin 1.",
      "For each x in the second conclusion, there exist real numbers u and v, chosen within that x's scope, representing the time and space derivatives at (x,t)."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "Write Q(x,s)(i)=q(x,s) for i ∈ Fin 1, A(i,j)=c, and F(state)=A state. For every a,b,s ∈ Real, x ↦ Q(x,s) is interval integrable with respect to real volume from a to b, and τ ↦ ∫_a^b Q(x,τ) dx has derivative F(Q(a,s))−F(Q(b,s)) at s.",
      "For every x ∈ Real, τ ↦ Q(x,τ) has derivative qt(x) at t.",
      "For every x ∈ Real, ξ ↦ Q(ξ,t) has derivative qx(x) at x.",
      "For every x ∈ Real, ξ ↦ F(Q(ξ,t)) has derivative fluxx(x) at x.",
      "For every a,b ∈ Real, qt is interval integrable from a to b with respect to real volume.",
      "For every a,b ∈ Real, fluxx is interval integrable from a to b with respect to real volume.",
      "For every a,b ∈ Real, τ ↦ ∫_a^b Q(x,τ) dx has derivative ∫_a^b qt(x) dx at the selected time t.",
      "The function x ↦ qt(x)+fluxx(x) from Real to V is continuous."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "For every state ∈ V, F(state) is the function on Fin 1 whose value at every index is c·state(0).",
      "For every x ∈ Real, there exist u,v ∈ Real such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative u at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative v at x, and u+c·v=0."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Fin 1 is the singleton index set {0}; V=Real^{Fin 1} is a one-dimensional real vector space with pointwise arithmetic and its usual product topology and norm.",
      "Q is the scalar-to-vector embedding Q(x,s)(0)=q(x,s).",
      "A is the one-by-one matrix [c], and F(state)(i)=Σ_{j∈Fin 1} A(i,j)state(j).",
      "All integrals use real Lebesgue volume. The oriented integral ∫_a^b f is the integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a].",
      "Interval integrability means integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a]; this handles either ordering of endpoints.",
      "A derivative assertion means existence of the ordinary two-sided real-variable derivative with the specified value. For V-valued functions it is equivalently the assertion for their sole real coordinate.",
      "The scalar transport predicate at (x,t) means existence of the two partial derivatives there and the equation ∂q/∂t(x,t)+c·∂q/∂x(x,t)=0.",
      "The existential witnesses in the conclusion are not syntactically identified with the input functions qt and qx, but uniqueness of derivatives forces u=qt(x)(0) and v=qx(x)(0)."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For any real scalar field q(x,s), any real constant speed c, any real time t, and any one-component derivative fields qt, qx, and fluxx, assume the following. At every real time s, the embedded field Q is integrable on every bounded spatial interval, and the time derivative of its oriented interval integral equals the flux at the left endpoint minus the flux at the right endpoint, where the flux is multiplication by the one-by-one matrix [c]. At time t, Q has time derivative qt(x) and space derivative qx(x) at every x, and its flux has space derivative fluxx(x). Both qt and fluxx are integrable on every bounded interval. Differentiating each interval integral at t gives the interval integral of qt, and qt+fluxx is continuous in space. Then both of the following hold: the flux of every one-component state is the one-component vector with value c times its coordinate at 0; and at every real spatial point x, q has scalar time and space derivatives at (x,t) whose values u and v satisfy u+c·v=0."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The target is scalar and one-dimensional in both space and state. The more general finite-index and normed-space dependencies do not make this target a theorem about arbitrary systems or spatial dimensions.",
    "Space and time range over all real numbers. There is no restriction to nonnegative time, a bounded spatial domain, or an interior subset.",
    "Speed is one fixed real constant, independent of space and time, with no positivity or nonzero assumption. At speed zero, the scalar equation reduces to vanishing time derivative while spatial differentiability remains required.",
    "The integral balance and integrability of Q are assumed at every real time. The additional pointwise derivative, derivative-integrability, interchange, and residual-continuity assumptions concern the selected time t.",
    "The conclusion concerns every x at the selected time t. It does not assert that the additional regularity assumptions hold at every time.",
    "The time-derivative/interchange condition is explicitly assumed for every interval; it is not derived from the other regularity hypotheses by the proposition.",
    "Only the sum qt+fluxx is assumed continuous. Separate continuity of qt, qx, or fluxx, joint continuity of partial derivatives, and global C1 regularity are not explicitly assumed.",
    "The conclusion is pointwise and asserts actual derivative existence. It is not merely an almost-everywhere, distributional, or weak transport equation.",
    "No ordering a≤b is required. When a=b the integral statements are trivial, but quantification over all endpoint pairs prevents the interval hypotheses from reducing to that degenerate case.",
    "Fin 1 is inhabited, so neither the state-coordinate assertions nor the matrix sum are vacuous through an empty index set.",
    "Integrability is required on each bounded interval, not over the whole real line. The explicit interval-integrability hypotheses ensure the relevant integrals are genuine integrals rather than relying on totalized values for nonintegrable functions.",
    "The first conclusion is an algebraic consequence of the flux definition alone. The statement does not derive or identify an unknown physical flux from the integral balance law.",
    "This is a conditional theorem, not an existence or uniqueness theorem for solutions. No initial data, boundary conditions, characteristic formula, or converse implication is encoded.",
    "For data failing any assumption the implication makes no claim about the transport equation. The assumptions are not inherently contradictory: the zero field with zero derivative fields satisfies them for every speed and selected time."
